name: Agnai
ontology_notes: MemoryBook kind:'memory' with MemoryEntry {name, entry, keywords, priority, weight, enabled} in common/types/memory.ts. Character persona/scenario/sampleChat are always-on card fields. Chat.memoryId, Chat.userEmbedId, UserEmbed and ChatEmbed types exist. V2 lorebook fields (constant, selective, recursiveScanning) are stored but buildMemoryPrompt does not implement them. No relationship type. Chat.mode can be 'companion'.

ontology.evidence: common/types/memory.ts MemoryBook/MemoryEntry plus UserEmbed/ChatEmbed. common/memory.ts CharacterBook maps V2 keys/content/insertion_order but recursive_scanning has 'no agnai equivalent'. ScenarioBook is a separate event system, not relationship state.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: User authors MemoryBook.entries (common/types/memory.ts). Chat.userEmbedId and UserEmbed/ChatEmbed types exist. common/memory.ts buildMemoryPrompt only keyword-matches books. No fact extractor in that file. Chat-embed ingest implementation was not fully read.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: buildMemoryPrompt in common/memory.ts: scan last memoryDepth lines (presetDefaults.memoryDepth=50), keyword regex via createRegexForKeyword, sort byPriorityThenAge, fill memoryContextLimit (default 500 tokens), then byWeightThenAge. Depth<=0 skips memory. Keyword miss injects nothing.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: getMatchesWithinBudget keeps adding until budget. No delete of an older contradicting entry. enabled=false is manual.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Match.messageAge is recency of the triggering chat line. UserEmbed has a date field. No 'last Tuesday' query in buildMemoryPrompt. Logged-in clients only receive 100 messages until scroll-up (instructions/memory.md).
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Character vs Profile handle vs MemoryBook.userId vs chat.userEmbedId. Relationship is prose in entries. BOT_REPLACE/SELF_REPLACE substitute names in entry text.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Disable entry or do not mention keywords. memoryDepth 0 disables the book. No silence ontology.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Matched entry text is concatenated into the memory prompt. No trust tags. Wildcard keyword '*' matches anything if depth allows (instructions/memory.md).
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: enabled flag, delete book, or User.disableLTM on the user record (schema.ts) whose runtime effect was not fully traced this pass.
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: Keyword path is local. presetDefaults.memoryContextLimit is 500 tokens in common/default-preset.ts. User.useLocalPipeline exists on the user schema. Per-turn embed call count depends on an ingest path not fully read.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: AGPL-3.0. Memory matching 'all happens in your browser' for logged-in keyword scan of loaded lines. Self-host supported. Guest users get full history in the client (instructions/memory.md).
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No official MCP memory server in the repo snapshot used for this card.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Same keyword-lore plus optional embeds pattern as ST, with a small explicit token budget. Alive public repo (stars 782, pushed 2026-06-15). Still no typed relationship state. V2 recursive/constant flags are carried, not executed, in buildMemoryPrompt.
